name: founder_edtech
description: Edit profile for founder-led, build-in-public edtech short-form (vertical talking-head, college-admissions niche). Defaults are derived from the Learning Corpus decision-rules: tight 20-30s cuts, aggressive dead-air trimming, frequent visual change, animated keyword captions, platform-loud audio, and a closing comment-bait CTA.
_added_text_note: FACE-reel surface: on-screen text must be spoken-word captions ONLY. No hook cards, stat/quote/CTA cards, wordmarks, titles, labels, or banners (engine/templates/* cards are for product videos, not face reels). The CTA is spoken or lives in the post caption, never an on-screen endcard. See engine/SURFACES.md.
